verdict: Maybe, for a strong engineering team. On2Cook pitched a hybrid cooktop that combines induction and microwave to cook much faster on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Restaurants and busy homes want faster cooking, but new appliances need proof of safety and reliability.
angle: Commercial kitchens pay for speed because it means more orders per hour. New cooking technology needs demonstrations and certification. Restaurants and cloud kitchens are the first buyers.
